00049 FFTMagnitudeUGenInternal::FFTMagnitudeUGenInternal(UGen const& input, 
00050                                                    FFTEngine const& fft, 
00051                                                    const int overlap, 
00052                                                    const int firstBin, 
00053                                                    const int numBins) throw()
00054 :   ProxyOwnerUGenInternal(NumInputs, numBins-1),
00055     fftEngine(fft),
00056     fftSize(fftEngine.size()),
00057     fftSizeHalved(fftSize / 2), 
00058     overlap_(overlap < 1 ? 1 : overlap),
00059     hopSize(fftSize / overlap),
00060     overlapSize(fftSize - hopSize),
00061     firstBin_(firstBin < fftSizeHalved ? firstBin : fftSizeHalved),
00062     maxNumBins(fftSizeHalved - firstBin_ + 1),
00063     numBins_(numBins ? (numBins < maxNumBins ? numBins : maxNumBins) : maxNumBins),
00064     inputBuffer(BufferSpec(fftSize, 1, true)),
00065     outputBuffer(BufferSpec(fftSize, 1, true)),
00066     bufferIndex(fftSize - hopSize),
00067     magnitudes(BufferSpec(numBins_, 1, true)),
00068     outputSampleData(new float*[numBins_])
00069 {
00070     ugen_assert(overlap == overlap_);   // should be > 0
00071     ugen_assert(firstBin == firstBin_); // should be in range
00072     
00073     inputs[Input] = input;
00074 }
00075 
00076 FFTMagnitudeUGenInternal::~FFTMagnitudeUGenInternal()
00077 {
00078     delete [] outputSampleData;
00079 }
00080 
00081 inline static void splat(float *buffer, float value, int n)
00082 {
00083     ugen_assert(buffer == 0);
00084     ugen_assert(n > 0);
00085     
00086     while(n--)
00087         *buffer++ = value;
00088 }
00089

00091 
00092 void FFTMagnitudeUGenInternal::processBlock(bool& shouldDelete, const unsigned int blockID, const int /*channel*/) throw()
00093 {
00094     const int blockSize = uGenOutput.getBlockSize();
00095     int numSamplesToProcess = blockSize;
00096     float* inputSamples = inputs[Input].processBlock(shouldDelete, blockID, 0);
00097     float* bufferSamples = inputBuffer.getData();
00098     
00099     // get output pointers
00100     for(int channel = 0; channel < numBins_; channel++)
00101     {
00102         outputSampleData[channel] = proxies[channel]->getSampleData();
00103     }   
00104     
00105     
00106     while(numSamplesToProcess > 0)
00107     {
00108         int bufferSamplesToProcess = fftSize - bufferIndex;
00109         
00110         if(bufferSamplesToProcess > numSamplesToProcess)
00111         {                           
00112             memcpy(bufferSamples + bufferIndex, inputSamples, numSamplesToProcess * sizeof(float));
00113             
00114             bufferIndex += numSamplesToProcess;
00115             inputSamples += numSamplesToProcess;
00116             numSamplesToProcess = 0;
00117         }
00118         else
00119         {
00120             numSamplesToProcess -= bufferSamplesToProcess;
00121                                     
00122             memcpy(bufferSamples + bufferIndex, inputSamples, bufferSamplesToProcess * sizeof(float));
00123             
00124             bufferIndex += bufferSamplesToProcess;
00125             inputSamples += bufferSamplesToProcess;
00126             bufferSamplesToProcess = 0;
00127             
00128             fftEngine.fft(outputBuffer, inputBuffer, true);
00129             
00130             magnitudes = fftEngine.rawToMagnitude(outputBuffer, firstBin_, numBins_);
00131             
00132             if(overlap_ > 1)
00133             {
00134                 memcpy(inputBuffer.getData(), inputBuffer.getData() + hopSize, overlapSize * sizeof(float));
00135                 bufferIndex = fftSize - hopSize;
00136             }
00137             else
00138             {
00139                 bufferIndex = 0;
00140             }
00141         }
00142         
00143         const int outputSamplesToProcess = hopSize < blockSize ? hopSize : blockSize;
00144         
00145         for(int channel = 0; channel < numBins_; channel++)
00146         {
00147             float magnitude = magnitudes.getSampleUnchecked(channel);
00148             
00149             splat(outputSampleData[channel], magnitude, outputSamplesToProcess);
00150             
00151             outputSampleData[channel] += outputSamplesToProcess;
00152         }   
00153         
00154     }
00155     
00156 }

00158 FFTMagnitude::FFTMagnitude(UGen const& input, 
00159                            FFTEngine const& fft, 
00160                            const int overlap, 
00161                            const int firstBin, 
00162                            const int numBins) throw()
00163 {
00164     int overlapChecked = Bits::isPowerOf2(overlap) ? overlap : Bits::nextPowerOf2(overlap);
00165     
00166     ugen_assert(overlap != overlapChecked); // should be power of 2
00167     
00168     FFTMagnitudeUGenInternal *fftMag = new FFTMagnitudeUGenInternal(input.mix(), 
00169                                                                     fft, 
00170                                                                     overlapChecked, 
00171                                                                     firstBin, 
00172                                                                     numBins);
00173         
00174     initInternal(fftMag->getNumBins());
00175     generateFromProxyOwner(fftMag);
00176 }
